title: Exact geometric stalks and the constant-complex retraction
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A$ a commutative ring, and $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. On the small etale site $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] let $A_T$ be the constant ring sheaf and $c(M)=\underline M$ the constant $A_T$-module sheaf of an ordinary $A$-module $M$ [def-kun-constant-sheaf]. Write $S(F)=F_{\bar t}$ for the geometric stalk with its induced $A$-module action [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Use sheaves of modules over $A_T$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and apply $S$ and $c$ termwise to unbounded cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $C$ be any such complex of $A_T$-module sheaves and $E$ any such complex of ordinary $A$-modules. Both are exact additive functors on their respective abelian categories, and there are natural $A$-linear cohomology isomorphisms
$$H^n(SC)\cong S(H^n(C)),\qquad H^n(cE)\cong c(H^n(E))\quad(n\in\mathbf Z).$$
Consequently each termwise functor preserves acyclic complexes and quasi-isomorphisms. There is a natural chain isomorphism $\eta_E:E\xrightarrow{\sim}S(cE)$ whose degree-$n$ component sends $e\in E^n$ to the germ at $(T,\bar t)$ of its constant section. In particular $S(A_T)\cong A$ has the ordinary scalar action. All assertions hold for arbitrary unbounded complexes, without any finiteness hypothesis on $A$.
